name: practice-based-learning
mission: Improve independent performance through realistic practice, retrieval and corrective feedback.
composition_rules: Use the two focused methods in declared order; review evidence before claiming progress or value.
Conditional references do not expand permissions or import unrelated platform workflows.

activation: Explicitly load PERSONA.md in the chosen profile after installing every member. Host permissions and user constraints take precedence.
stop_rules: Stop when required evidence or approval is missing.
Stop at the bounded cycle budget; no unbounded retries.

all_must_hold: Unknowns and approval boundaries remain explicit.
